note.PENDING_VALIDATION: Applying Validator rules and risk tiering; usually done within seconds.
note.BLOCKED: At least one blocking rule failed; this change set can't be approved.
note.PENDING_APPROVAL: Waiting for an approver with sufficient permission; it expires if not reviewed in time.
note.EXECUTED: All operations were written to Google Ads.
note.FAILED: Some or all operations failed to write; see each operation's error.
note.REJECTED: Rejected by the reviewer; nothing was written.
note.STALE: The target changed after this was proposed, so the original values no longer hold; the change set is void.
note.EXPIRED: Not reviewed before the deadline; expired automatically.
note.SIMULATED: This feature is in Shadow mode: fully validated and tiered but not written. Feedback was collected in Slack.
note.REVERTED: This change was reverted by Undo.

submitted.confirm: Tier 3 approval sent; writing to Google Ads.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.subtitle: AI classifies each search term's intent and relevance against the Business Profile; irrelevant terms are proposed as negative keywords.

searchTerms.emptyBody: The account had no search terms in this period.
searchTerms.awaitingScan: New term, waiting for the next classification run.

hint.DailyBudgetCap: No campaign's daily budget may exceed this; budget cuts aren't limited.
hint.MonthlySpendCap: Spend so far this month + remaining days × new daily budget may not exceed this (Requirement 5.5).
hint.MaxChangePct: The cumulative change to one budget or bid target within the window may not exceed this.
hint.BidTargetRange: Target CPA (amount) or target ROAS (%) must stay in range.
hint.MaxMutationsPerDay: Max changes executed per day for the account (or campaign).

rules.title: Validator rules
rules.subtitle: Every change set is checked against these rules before review. If a blocking rule fails nobody can approve it; a warning makes the change set require review.
rules.emptyBody: Without rules, every change is tiered only by the tier thresholds.
rules.deleteBody: {label}: {condition} ({scope}). Takes effect immediately and can't be undone.

form.scopeHint: Narrower scopes win: campaign rules override account rules, which override organization rules.

hint.SpendPacing: Triggers when today's spend ÷ (daily budget × share of the day elapsed) exceeds the threshold.
hint.SpendNearCap: Triggers when this month's spend reaches the given share of MonthlySpendCap (set up a monthly spend cap rule first).
hint.CpaSpike: Triggers when CPA over N hours exceeds K × target CPA with at least M conversions.
hint.RoasDrop: Triggers when ROAS over N hours falls below the given share of target ROAS with at least M conversions.

field.minSpendHint: Avoids false alarms from small early-morning spend
field.ratioHint: e.g. 50 = ROAS below half the target

action.reduce_target: Tighten bid target (lower tCPA / raise tROAS)

monitor.title: Monitor circuit breakers
monitor.subtitle: Pause or cut budget automatically when spend runs ahead or CPA spikes. Monitor evaluates every 15 minutes (after the snapshot sync) without using an LLM.
monitor.emptyBody: Once you add circuit breakers, Monitor stops the bleeding automatically on anomalies and reports in Slack.

form.campaignHint: Empty = every enabled campaign in the account
form.cooldownHint: Won't trigger again for this long after triggering
form.modeNote: What happens on trigger follows the circuit-breaker mode on the Automation page: Shadow only simulates and reports in Slack, Live executes with Undo, and Off creates no change set.

thresholds.title: Tier thresholds
thresholds.subtitle: Set each change set's risk tier. Tier 1 is protective (cut budget, pause, lower target CPA) and executes automatically with Undo; Tier 2 needs one reviewer; Tier 3 needs review plus a second confirmation and can't be approved by the proposer.
thresholds.orgApplied: Applies to accounts without their own thresholds
thresholds.tier1MaxReduceHint: Reductions within this count as protective (Tier 1)
thresholds.tier3PctHint: Increases or cuts beyond this become Tier 3
thresholds.tier3AmountHint: Daily budget changes larger than this become Tier 3

profile.subtitle: What search term classification and negative keywords are based on. One per account; every save creates a new version.

brandTerms.label: Brand terms
brandTerms.hint: Search terms with a brand term are never excluded automatically

profile.notSetBody: Without a Business Profile, search terms can't be classified and no negative keywords are proposed automatically.
profile.competitorPolicyHint: What to do when a search term contains a competitor's name
profile.examplesHint: Examples for the AI to judge by; the closer to real search terms the better. Negative terms excluded during review are added here automatically.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Roles: Viewer views · Operator proposes and undoes · Approver reviews (up to a max tier) · Admin manages settings. Roles can be limited to specific accounts.

users.notBound: Not linked. Link Slack to get notifications and review in Slack.
